name: NJ-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Norcross is a well-funded incumbent with $2.4M on hand
District leans Democratic by about 10 points
Challenger Galdo raised only ~$11K with no outside support
model.rationale: Norcross holds a strong financial and incumbency advantage in a district that leans Democratic, while Galdo has raised almost nothing and drawn no outside spending. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy incumbent win.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Norcross or an unusually strong national Republican environment could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Donald Norcross seeks another term in a South Jersey district that has favored Democrats by double digits. He enters the general election with a large war chest of about $2.4 million, while Republican Damon Galdo has raised roughly $11,000 and has no visible outside support. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Norcross about a 94% chance of winning.

The fundamentals align with that picture: the district's partisan lean, Norcross's incumbency advantage, and the stark fundraising gap all favor the incumbent. Barring an unexpected late development, this race is expected to remain comfortably in Democratic hands.
